shortBio.en: Joined Maiden 1981; operatic mid-range locks Beast-era global peak.
shortBio.zh: 1981 加入 Maiden；歌剧式中音区锁死 Beast 时期全球峰值。

whyHub.en: Singer swap Di'Anno → Dickinson without abandoning Harris gallop DNA.
whyHub.zh: Di'Anno → Dickinson 主唱替换，不丢 Harris 疾驰 DNA。

body.en:
Born 1958. Replaces Di'Anno 1981. Number of the Beast through Seventh Son set arena NWOBHM vocals. Leaves 1993; returns 1999.

Hub: vocal upgrade on existing riff architecture.
body.zh:
1958 年生。1981 替换 Di'Anno。Number of the Beast 至 Seventh Son 定下体育场 NWOBHM 人声。1993 离队；1999 回归。

枢纽：在既有 riff 架构上的人声升级。
